listing.name: Resident Evil CODE: Veronica X (PS2) (RECVX Native)
listing.summary: An unfinished Resident Evil CODE: Veronica X PS2 engine with source-only preparation from your own ISO, including extraction and movie setup. Development is documented for Apple Silicon macOS, Windows x86-64 and native Windows ARM64; general validated desktop releases remain planned. It is not a complete playable game. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
